request.style: English, female solo voice with ethereal choir, Celtic harp, bodhran, fiddle, flute, atmospheric pads, mournful yet hopeful, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Deep calls to deep at the thunder of waterfalls
All your breakers and waves have swept over me
By day the Lord commands his steadfast love
At night his song is with me in prayer

[Chorus]
Why are you cast down, my soul
Why do you groan within me
Hope in God for I will praise him again
My salvation and my God

[Verse]
I say to God my rock why have you forgotten me
Why must I go about in mourning oppressed
The enemy presses in with cold and silence
My bones feel like a deadly wound

[Chorus]
Why are you cast down, my soul
Why do you groan within me
Hope in God for I will praise him again
My salvation and my God

[Bridge]
Adversaries taunt me all day long
They ask where is your God
But the Lord commands his love by day
His song remains with me by night

[Chorus]
Why are you cast down, my soul
Why do you groan within me
Hope in God for I will praise him again
My salvation and my God

[Outro]
Hope in God for I will praise him again
My salvation and my God
